related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve how effectively MNCS language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents through evidence from real development.

outcome.implementation_change: Correction validation now accepts a non-observation source whose exact content was verified by the bounded read-only workspace lookup even when it is absent from the selected campaign evidence page. The projection retains page-local registration status separately from content integrity.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The live page shows that the prior exact correction and native-capability source link now resolve. It does not establish that the pressure caused a specific host boundary, that agents used the native API, or that migration is ready.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Page-local evidence registration can mask independently verified correction sources
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment campaign correction validation and capability-accountability projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The authenticated page-zero projection rejected one correction while its P-001 replacement source was independently digest-verified from a read-only workspace checkout and explicitly absent only from the selected campaign evidence page.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Keep page-local registration separate from content integrity: allow a non-observation replacement source when its exact blob is independently verified through bounded read-only workspace access, while preserving both statuses in the projection.
not_measured: how often other append-only corrections use sources absent from their selected campaign pages
whether an agent relied on the rejected correction or missing accountability link
whether this behavior occurs in other projection or repository workflows
cross-session recurrence or long-term improvement effectiveness

improvement_relation.basis: The validator distinguishes campaign-page registration from independently verified source content. A focused regression covers an exact digest-verified source absent from the page, and the authenticated live projection applies the prior correction and exposes the native-capability source relationship.
not_measured: whether later agents discover or use the linked capability
whether later campaigns encounter the same correction pattern
whether this change improves migration readiness or changes host implementation ownership
long-term behavior across other source kinds and workspace configurations

measurement_limits: The live projection covers a bounded evidence page and has partial status.
The correction establishes exact provenance and source integrity, not causal blocking or implementation ownership.
No subsequent independent session has established lasting effectiveness.
